Regeneration Manager 
Job Type: Temporary contract, initially 6 months
Location: NW1, London
Day Rate: Negotiable
Reed is recruiting for a Regeneration Manager on behalf of a large housing association in London. This is an excellent opportunity for a Regeneration Manager with experience in resident engagement, decanting and regeneration projects to support the delivery of key schemes across a varied housing portfolio.
The successful Regeneration Manager will work closely with senior colleagues to support residents and stakeholders through the regeneration process, ensuring strong communication, effective engagement and a positive customer experience throughout.
Day to day of the role 
Support residents and home-owners affected by regeneration projects, including housing needs assessments, decanting and return moves.
Act as a visible presence in the community, building trust and promoting engagement with regeneration activity.
Drive resident involvement by setting up and supporting Resident Steering Groups and other engagement forums.
Encourage residents to take part in consultation and design activity wherever possible.
Work across multiple regeneration projects, managing competing priorities and maintaining accurate records.
Identify housing needs survey requirements and create suitable tracking tools, including forms and spreadsheets.
Keep housing needs data up to date throughout each stage of the regeneration process.
Support the planning and delivery of consultation materials, engagement events and resident communications.
Manage budgets and payments linked to decanting, moving arrangements and resident support.
Required skills & qualifications 
Experience of working within regeneration, housing or a related property environment.
Good understanding of the regeneration process, redevelopment and planning matters.
Knowledge of housing management, lettings and neighbourhood management issues.
Experience of complex resident decants, including associated payments, support and move management.
Strong background in resident engagement, consultation and community-focused project work.
Experience of managing several projects at once and working with minimal supervision.
Confident using Excel and similar tools to monitor, track and maintain housing needs data.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage a wide range of audiences.
Strong customer focus and a clear commitment to delivering a high-quality resident experience.
Benefits 
Negotiable day rate.
Initial 6-month temporary assignment with the potential for further opportunity.
Chance to work on meaningful regeneration projects within a large housing association.
Varied role with a strong mix of resident engagement, project support and stakeholder liaison.
Opportunity to make a direct impact on customer experience and community outcomes.
How to apply

jobs.details_text:
Homelessness Prevention & Resettlement Manager 
We are seeking an experienced and compassionate manager to lead homelessness prevention and resettlement services, helping people secure and sustain safe homes. 
Location: Southend-on-Sea
Salary: Starting at £37,035, rising incrementally to £41,585
Hours: 37 hours per week
Contract: Permanent
Closing Date: Friday 13 November 2026 at 12 noon
About the role 
Are you an experienced housing or homelessness professional ready to take the next step in your leadership career
This is an opportunity to lead vital services supporting people experiencing homelessness or at risk of losing their homes. You will oversee rapid resettlement, reconnection and private rented sector pathways, ensuring individuals receive the practical, person-centred support they need to secure and maintain suitable accommodation.
Working with a dedicated team, you will help improve housing outcomes, build strong partnerships and make a lasting difference to people's lives.
Key responsibilities include: 
Lead, motivate and support a team delivering homelessness prevention, resettlement and reconnection services.
Oversee assessments, case management and individual support plans, ensuring a trauma-informed approach.
Develop relationships with landlords, letting agents, local authorities and partner organisations to increase housing opportunities.
Ensure effective safeguarding, risk management and crisis intervention.
Oversee tenancy sustainment support, helping individuals maintain accommodation and prevent repeat homelessness.
Monitor service performance, maintain accurate records and identify opportunities for improvement.
Promote a positive, supportive working environment focused on staff development and high-quality service delivery.
About you 
We are looking for a confident, approachable leader who understands the challenges faced by people experiencing homelessness and is passionate about delivering meaningful change.
You will bring:
Experience working within homelessness, housing, resettlement or tenancy sustainment services.
Previous experience managing or supervising staff within housing or support services.
Strong knowledge of housing legislation, welfare benefits, tenancy rights and the private rented sector.
Experience of case management, safeguarding and managing complex situations.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to build effective partnerships.
A practical, organised approach with the confidence to make decisions and manage competing priorities.
A commitment to person-centred, trauma-informed support and inclusive working practices.
A relevant Level 3 qualification or above is desirable but not essential.
Some evening and weekend working may be required. An Enhanced DBS check is required.
About the organisation 
You will be joining a charity dedicated to tackling homelessness and helping people build safer, more stable futures.
Working collaboratively with local authorities, housing providers and community partners, the organisation delivers practical support to people facing housing insecurity and multiple disadvantages.
Committed to equality, diversity and inclusion, the charity welcomes applications from all backgrounds, particularly those with lived experience of homelessness.
Other roles you may have experience of could include: Homelessness Service Manager, Housing Services Manager, Resettlement Manager, Supported Housing Manager, Housing Support Manager, Tenancy Sustainment Manager, Homelessness Prevention Manager, Move On Manager or Outreach Services Manager.

jobs.details_text:
Content Writer
Salary: £35,000
Location: Taplow
We are recruiting for a Content Writer to help shape and share the story of a humanitarian organisation and the impact of its work. This is an excellent opportunity for a strong writer with a passion for meaningful storytelling, who can turn complex updates from programmes, fundraising and operations into clear, compelling and human-centred content.
The Content Writer will work across communications, fundraising and programme teams to produce engaging content that builds awareness, strengthens supporter engagement and inspires action. This Content Writer position would suit someone creative, organised and confident writing for a range of audiences and channels.
Day-to-day of the role
Support the delivery of the content strategy and editorial plan, ensuring content reflects organisational values, priorities and campaigns
Research, write and edit content across multiple channels, including website copy, blogs, newsletters, fundraising appeals, donor communications and project updates
Turn field reports, interviews and programme information into accessible and engaging stories for public audiences
Develop fundraising and campaign messaging, including headlines, calls to action, scripts, captions and promotional copy
Create dignified, accurate and human-centred stories that highlight both individual experiences and wider programme impact
Proofread and strengthen content produced across the organisation, ensuring clarity, consistency, accuracy and alignment with tone of voice
Work closely with digital and communications colleagues to repurpose stories across web, email, social media and video content
Support external communications such as press releases, media statements and briefing materials when required
Maintain an organised library of content, case studies and quotes, while monitoring performance to improve future engagement
Support urgent communications during humanitarian emergencies, adapting quickly to changing priorities and deadlines
Required Skills & Qualifications
Degree in Marketing, Communications or a related field, or equivalent professional experience in content writing
Proven experience writing, editing and proofreading high-quality content for a range of audiences and formats
Excellent written communication skills with the ability to simplify complex issues into engaging and accessible content
Experience producing both long-form and short-form content, including blogs, newsletters, social media copy and video scripts
Knowledge of SEO and Google Analytics
Strong attention to detail, with the ability to fact-check and maintain high editorial standards
Ability to work collaboratively across teams and build strong relationships with internal stakeholders

jobs.details_text:
Housing Maintenance Administration Officer 
Location: East of England
Rate: £25 per hour (Negotiable) 
Contract: 4 - Months ongoing
Spencer Clarke Group are supporting a local authority to appoint a Housing Maintenance Administration Officer within the Homes and Properties (Housing Repairs and Maintenance) service.
This is a busy, customer facing admin role supporting planners and surveyors, helping to keep repairs, compliance activity and tenant communications running smoothly. You will also support with enquiries, satisfaction feedback and early resolution of issues before they escalate to complaints.
Responsibilities include 
* Providing day to day administrative support to the housing repairs and maintenance team, including planners and surveyors
* Acting as a key point of contact between tenants/leaseholders, customer services and operational teams to help resolve queries quickly
* Managing repair related communications, keeping residents updated on progress and follow up actions (including occasional visits where needed)
* Supporting customer satisfaction activity, including collating responses, spotting themes and feeding into KPI reporting
* Assisting with casework support for complaints, disrepair queries and ombudsman related activity, ensuring information is accurate and timely
* Managing damp, condensation and mould correspondence, raising inspections, tracking follow on works and keeping stakeholders informed through to completion
* Raising and chasing works with contractors, monitoring updates and escalating where needed to protect service standards and timescales
* Maintaining accurate records across systems, ensuring notes and files are kept up to date and easy to retrieve
About you 
* Experience in a similar administration role, ideally within social housing, repairs or maintenance environments
* Strong customer service skills with the confidence to deal with residents sensitively and professionally
* Good IT skills including Microsoft Office and confidence working across multiple systems and inboxes
* Excellent organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast paced team
* Confidence handling enquiries and supporting complaint prevention through clear communication and problem solving
* Ability to produce basic reports or management information and accurately record actions and outcomes

Job Title: Housing Liaison Officer
Location: Newham
Rate: £21.91 PAYE hour
Term: Temp, initially 3 months
Mainly on site on the Estates engaging with residents, as well as some anchor days in the office.
Our client, a reputable organisation dedicated to providing excellent resident services, is seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Housing Liaison Officer to join their dynamic team. This role is crucial in ensuring a seamless connection between residents and housing services, while promoting a safe and compliant living environment.
Key Responsibilities: 
Monitor and respond to resident enquiries through various channels, including in-person, phone, and correspondence.
Conduct interviews with residents via phone, in the office, or through home visits as necessary.
Provide expert advice on fire safety and housing compliance to ensure residents are well-informed.
Coordinate and facilitate resident meetings, forums, and multi-agency site visits, ensuring comprehensive minute-taking.
Perform regular inspections of properties to identify and address fire safety hazards promptly.
Manage and investigate breaches of lease and tenancy agreements, collaborating with other services and agencies.
Support vulnerable residents in sustaining their tenancies and navigating any tenancy breaches.
Promote a variety of payment methods and assist residents in accessing financial support.
Attend court or tribunal sessions as required, representing the organisation effectively.
Ideal Candidate: 
The successful candidate will demonstrate a proactive approach, strong communication skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with various stakeholders. A commitment to providing exceptional customer service and a passion for enhancing resident experiences are essential.
Skills: 
A demonstrable understanding of multi tenure housing management.
Specialist knowledge in at least one of the following areas:
Fire Safety
Tenancy Audit
Resident Engagement
Housing Compliance
Block Management

jobs.details_text:
Previous applicants need not apply
Background 
Wave Active is an award-winning charity and social enterprise, supporting our local communities with facilities, activities, and services to inspire active lifestyles.
Our purpose is to “Inspire Active Lifestyles” and vision, “To be at the heart of the improvement of health and wellbeing in the Community”.
We are passionate about providing services and opportunities that support individuals to gain, regain or maintain health, fitness and wellbeing improvements. Managing a number of leisure facilities and Newhaven Fort, across the Lewes District and Eastbourne Borough of East Sussex we provide health and fitness services for both members and non-members of all ages to participate in, whether that be through sport, group exercise, gym, swim, play or health services.
The Post in Context 
To lead the development, implementation and continuous improvement of Wave Active’s health, safety and environmental compliance framework, ensuring the organisation meets all statutory and regulatory obligations, fostering a positive culture of safety, accountability and continuous improvement.
The post holder will act as the organisation’s competent Health & Safety advisor, oversee environmental compliance and monitoring, lead information governance and data protection arrangements, and provide assurance to the SLT Team and Board that organisational risks are effectively identified, managed and monitored.
Key Responsibilities 
Health & Safety Leadership 
Develop and deliver the organisation’s Health & Safety Strategy.
Ensure compliance with all relevant health and safety legislation.
Oversee Planned and Reactive Maintenance programmes.
Maintain and review Health & Safety policies and procedures.
Lead accident, incident and near-miss investigations, identifying root causes and implementing improvements.
Oversee risk assessment programmes and safe systems of work.
Manage fire safety arrangements and emergency planning.
Ensure statutory inspections are completed.
Monitor contractor safety and permit-to-work systems.
Provide professional advice to managers and staff.
Deliver health and safety training across the organisation.
Prepare performance reports for SLT and Board.
Compliance & Governance 
Maintain the relevant compliance framework, ensuring compliance with statutory, regulatory and contractual obligations.
Develop relevant compliance monitoring programmes.
Coordinate internal compliance audits.
Support external audits and regulatory inspections.
Maintain relevant organisational policies and governance documentation.
Monitor related legislative changes and advise on implications.
Promote continual improvement across all relevant and related systems.
Data Protection & Information Governance 
Act as the organisation’s Data Protection Officer
Ensure compliance with UK GDPR and Data Protection legislation.
Maintain privacy notices and records of processing.
Lead Data Protection Impact Assessments.
Manage subject access requests.
Investigate data breaches.
Deliver GDPR training.
Advise managers on information governance risks.
Environmental Management 
Lead environmental compliance.
Develop sustainability initiatives.
Monitor environmental legislation.
Ensure compliance with environmental permits where applicable.
Reduce waste, energy consumption and carbon emissions.
Lead environmental reporting.
Support achievement of environmental objectives.
Promote sustainable operational practices.
Risk Management 
Maintain the corporate risk register.
Identify emerging compliance risks.
Support business continuity planning.
Coordinate organisational investigations where appropriate.
Monitor corrective actions.
Produce compliance dashboards and KPIs.
Provide assurance reporting to senior leadership.
Culture & Improvement 
Promote a proactive safety culture.
Coach managers in compliance responsibilities.
Develop awareness campaigns.
Encourage reporting of hazards and near misses.
Benchmark against sector best practice.
Drive continuous improvement across all compliance systems.
Key Accountabilities 
The postholder will be accountable for:
Health & Safety compliance.
Data Protection compliance.
Environmental compliance.
Corporate compliance framework.
Risk management systems.
Health & Safety Committee.
Incident reporting and investigations.
Compliance training.
Internal audits.
Regulatory inspections.

Experience (Essential) 
Managing Health & Safety within a multi-site organisation
Conducting investigations
Developing policies and procedures
Delivering training
Managing audits
GDPR compliance
Environmental monitoring and compliance
Producing reports for senior leadership
Influencing managers across an organisation
Qualifications (Essential) 
NEBOSH General Certificate (minimum)
IOSH Membership
Data Protection qualification (or willingness to obtain)
Full UK Driving Licence
Specialist Knowledge (Essential)

Management of Health & Safety Regulations
Fire Safety legislation
UK GDPR
Environmental legislation
Risk management
Relevant and related Audit methodology
Skills (Essential) 
Excellent communicator
Strong analytical ability
Investigation skills
Report writing
Influencing and coaching

Organised and able to prioritise.
High attention to detail
Success Measures

jobs.summary: Saab UK is part of Scandinavia's largest defence company, bringing together the best of Swedish and British innovation. Saab offers world-leading solutions and services in defence, aviation, space, and civil security to keep people and society safe. Our UK presence has been growing at pace, meaning we can offer a wide range of opportunities for personal fulfilment and career growth. We currently employ over 600 people across eight sites in the UK, and our specialisations include software engineering, underwater robotics, radars, AI, and armed forces training.
jobs.details_text:
Introduction 
Saab UK is part of Scandinavia's largest defence company, bringing together the best of Swedish and British innovation. Saab offers world-leading solutions and services in defence, aviation, space, and civil security to keep people and society safe. Our UK presence has been growing at pace, meaning we can offer a wide range of opportunities for personal fulfilment and career growth. We currently employ over 600 people across eight sites in the UK, and our specialisations include software engineering, underwater robotics, radars, AI, and armed forces training.
What you will be part of 
Saab is a leading defence and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe.Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world. Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defence capability of several nations.
The Role 
Reporting to the Head of Marketing and Communication, the Internal Communications and Engagement Manager will develop and deliver a communication strategy that ensures clear, consistent and engaging messaging across Saab UK. The role will support company culture, promote transparency and drive employee engagement through effective communication channels and campaigns. The successful candidate will lead the Internal Communications Specialist and work closely with senior leaders to enhance visibility, trust and alignment through authentic communications. They will champion Saab UK's values, foster a strong employee experience and ensure communications are relevant, inclusive and impactful for employees at all levels. This is a hands-on role within the Marketing and Communications team, supporting Saab UK's growing business through internal communications, employee engagement, digital content and basic design activities. The position is ideally based in London or the South East, with hybrid working available and occasional travel across the UK and to Sweden as required.
Key Responsibilities: 
Develop and deliver an internal communication strategy that aligns with the company's vision, values, and goals
Plan and manage communications campaigns to support key initiatives, business updates, and change programs
Embed company values into all aspects of internal communication to reinforce culture and employee alignment
Partner with senior leaders to increase visibility and drive consistent, transparent messaging from the top down
Create, edit, and manage engaging content across internal channels (e.g. intranet, newsletters, internal social platforms)
Support two-way communication by enabling feedback mechanisms such as surveys, Q&A sessions, and town halls
Provide strategic communication guidance and support to HR and leadership teams on employee engagement, culture, and change
Own and manage the internal communications calendar to ensure clear and timely delivery of messages
Measure and report on the effectiveness of communication strategies, using insights to improve future efforts
Coordinate and support internal events that enhance engagement, such as company updates, recognition programs, and culture-building activities
Ensure communication is accessible, inclusive, and tailored to diverse employee audiences
Maintain and enhance internal communication platforms, ensuring ease of use and effectiveness
Collaborate with the brand and marketing team as and when needed to support different initiatives and employer branding campaigns.
Qualifications and Skills: 
Required 
Proven experience in internal communications, employee engagement, or corporate communications.
Experience of driving cultural change in an organisation.
Strong organisational skills and proven ability to navigate ambiguity and prioritise.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging for different audiences and platforms.
Experience working with senior stakeholders and influencing at all levels of an organisation.
Being able to work as part of a close team, have a can-do attitude and be willing to take on any challenge with a natural air for problem solving.
Excellent written and editing skills, the ability to communicate clearly.
Ability to manage multiple projects and identify priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong understanding of employee engagement principles, culture-building, and change communication.
Comfortable using analytics and engagement metrics to inform communication planning.
Knowledge of inclusion and accessibility best practices in communication.
Degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, HR, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Desired 
Experience working in the defence or technology sectors would be a bonus but is not essential.
Saab UK Company Benefits: 
30 days annual leave
Workplace pension scheme with 8% company contribution
Private medical insurance
Group income protection scheme
Death in service insurance
Up to 5% share matching scheme
Company enhanced Maternity/Adoption & Paternity leave.
+ Much more
By submitting an application to Saab UK you consent to undertaking workforce screening activities that may include but are not limited to: Baseline Personnel Security checks, National Security Vetting, reference checks, verification of working rights and in all circumstances preferred candidates will be placed through a security interview.

jobs.details_text:
Group Volunteering Manager 
£35,000 per annum 
37 hours per week, Monday–Friday (Some evening and weekend working will be required)
Based in Whiteley, Hampshire or Chertsey, Surrey
Hybrid working offer 
Planned interviews: 1st & 2nd December 2026 (face to face in Hampshire, virtual option available if needed); subject to any changes 
Help us make volunteering matter! 
At Avenues Group, we believe in the power of people coming together to make a difference. Volunteers play an important role in building connections, strengthening communities and creating meaningful opportunities for the people we support.
We are looking for an enthusiastic, experienced and forward-thinking Group Volunteering Manager to lead and shape our volunteering approach across the organisation.
This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact by developing a consistent, inclusive and sustainable volunteering programme across Avenues. You will take the lead in creating our Group-wide volunteering strategy, attracting and developing volunteers, and building opportunities that support our services, community engagement, fundraising and peer-led initiatives.
Working closely with colleagues across our operational services, People, Recruitment, Fundraising and Communications teams, you will help embed volunteering into the way we work, ensuring our volunteers feel valued, supported and equipped to make a difference.
What will you be doing? 
You will take ownership of developing and delivering our Group-wide volunteering strategy, identifying opportunities to grow volunteering and ensuring we have the right structures, policies and processes in place to support its success.
A key part of your role will be leading the volunteer journey, from attraction and recruitment through to onboarding, training, development and recognition. You will champion inclusive recruitment approaches, creating accessible opportunities for people from diverse backgrounds, including those with lived experience and neurodivergent individuals.
You will also develop exciting new opportunities through corporate partnerships and an employee volunteering programme, working with businesses, community organisations and colleagues to build meaningful connections and maximise the contribution volunteers can make.
Alongside this, you will provide guidance and support to operational teams, ensuring volunteering is managed consistently and safely across Avenues. You will oversee volunteer policies, safeguarding, compliance, reporting and impact measurement, using data and feedback to continually improve the experience for volunteers and the people we support.
This is a role where you can combine strategic thinking with practical delivery, bringing people together and turning ideas into meaningful opportunities.
About you 
We are looking for someone who is passionate about volunteering and understands how to develop and sustain successful volunteer programmes.
You will bring:
Proven experience of recruiting, managing and developing volunteers, including developing or improving volunteer programmes.
Experience of implementing policies, procedures and processes, ensuring good practice, safeguarding and compliance.
Strong relationship-building and partnership-working skills, with the confidence to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels.
The ability to develop opportunities, motivate people and create an inclusive and positive volunteering culture.
Excellent organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and work independently.
Strong communication, IT and analytical skills, including experience of maintaining records, managing databases and producing reports.
You will have a good understanding of volunteer management best practice, safeguarding, equality, diversity and inclusion, GDPR and health and safety requirements.
Above all, you will be proactive, collaborative and motivated by making a difference. You will be comfortable working strategically while also getting involved in the practical detail, and you will share our commitment to inclusion, co-production and empowering people to have a voice and make choices.
Experience of volunteering within health, social care or community services, corporate volunteering, fundraising or peer-led initiatives would be an advantage. An understanding of autism, neurodiversity and learning disabilities would also be beneficial.
Why join Avenues Group? 
At Avenues, we are more than a care and support organisation. We are a community committed to helping people live fulfilling lives, achieve their ambitions and be part of the world around them.
Joining us means having the opportunity to shape something meaningful, build relationships across our organisation and wider communities, and see the positive impact of your work.
If you are passionate about bringing people together, creating opportunities and developing volunteering for the future, we would love to hear from you.
This role involves travel across Avenues locations, so access to suitable transport for business travel is essential.
What we offer 
In return, you'll join a supportive team where your contribution is valued and your development is encouraged. We offer: 
Hybrid working to support a healthy work-life balance. 
Generous paid annual leave. 
Learning and development opportunities to help you grow your career. 
Access to wellbeing support and employee initiatives. 
A collaborative and inclusive working environment where continuous improvement is encouraged.

jobs.details_text:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 
Curiosity : We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 
Collaboration : Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.
Commitment : We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.
WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.
Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
Job Title: Digital Strategist, Atlantic Records 
A little bit about our team: 
Atlantic Records UK is home to some of the most iconic UK artists from household names such as Ed Sheeran, Charli xcx & Fred Again… to emerging names such as Barry Can’t Swim Erin LeCount and Maisie Peters. 
You’d be joining the Atlantic UK digital team, who work hand in hand with marketing and our US counterparts to construct our artist campaigns; driving amplification online, growing audiences and galvanising fan communities forming around our artists. We’re looking for a highly dynamic digital marketeer with an innate curiosity to think two steps ahead of a constantly landscape, break artists and deliver best-in-class campaigns. 
Your role: 
As a Digital Strategist, you will be the driving force behind the end-to-end planning and execution of first-class campaigns for our artists, focused on engaging and growing their audience online. You’ll work in collaboration with a wide variety of stakeholders to ensure all touchpoints across social, content, community building, 1st-part data and creator strategy are leveraged to grow and engage fanbases. This role is a fantastic opportunity to further grow your skills as a digital marketeer in a super dynamic and creative environment whilst deliver campaigns for some of the world’s most exciting artists. 
Here you’ll get to: 
Manage a roster of artist campaigns; delivering digital marketing strategies covering the full spectrum of social, community, direct-to-fan and influencer marketing. 
Work closely with artists and managers to architect end-to-end (ideation, production, and distribution) content strategies for their campaigns across all major social platforms - actively contributing to the creative process. 
Drive the strategic direction and daily management of artist social media accounts, ensuring content is platform-native and optimised for engagement. 
Construct powerful content ecosystems around an artist beyond their owned social channels - encompassing asset supply and strategy around HQ, third-party and fan pages. 
Collaborate with the Direct-to-Fan and Community team to develop strategies and initiatives to grow and utilise our artist’s 1st party data as well as build and nurture fan communities across platforms like Discord, Reddit etc. 
Work closely with the Creator marketing team on influencer strategies, helping to identify briefs and key creators / pages to drive track-level usage and artist awareness. 
Source and collaborate with the best content creators and independently manage social-first content shoots, briefing suppliers, and ensure quality deliverables. 
Work closely with our social partners to deliver on platform support and best in class strategy across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snap 
Own campaign tracking, documentation, and reporting on assigned projects. 
Maintain constant use of data and insight tools to inform strategic decisions around your campaigns. 
About you: 
You love music. 
You are a true digital native deep with an understanding of marketing principles, best practice and growth tactics. 
An avid social media consumer with your finger on the pulse of internet culture. 
You have a minimum of 3 years experience of working across music marketing campaigns with a proven track record of success. 
You are innately curious, constantly driving towards new and evolved ways of approaching artist marketing with a strong interest in emerging trends. 
You are organised with an ability to manage tasks effectively and meet deadlines. 
You are a proactive learner, eager to develop your skills in digital marketing and the music industry. 
You are a clear communicator and a collaborative team player. 
You are data minded, and can use data to inform marketing decisions / report on campaign progress. 
We’d love it if you also had: 
Experience in creating or commissioning social-first content first-hand. 
Familiarity with digital marketing tools and analytics platforms. 
Label, management or agency experience working directly with artists. 
As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. Housing Resolutions Officer needed in North London Paying £21.41 per hr ref 000B 7367 / 1 
Full time hours on a temporary basis 
Key Responsibilities 
Manage and resolve housing-related enquiries, service requests, and complaints, ensuring a positive customer experience.
Investigate complex cases by gathering information, reviewing records, and liaising with relevant teams to identify appropriate solutions.

Identify root causes of recurring issues and recommend improvements to enhance service delivery and customer satisfaction.
Maintain accurate records of all cases, actions, correspondence, and outcomes using relevant systems and databases.
Monitor case progress to ensure enquiries and complaints are resolved within agreed service standards and timescales.
Analyse customer feedback, case trends, and performance data to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
Escalate complex or high-risk cases where appropriate and provide recommendations for resolution.
Support service improvement initiatives by sharing lessons learned and promoting best practice.
Build and maintain effective relationships with customers, colleagues, contractors, and external stakeholders.
Provide advice and guidance on housing services, policies, procedures, and available support options.
Produce reports, correspondence, and management information as required.
Handle sensitive and confidential information in line with data protection requirements.
Manage a diverse caseload, prioritising urgent matters and competing deadlines effectively.
Contribute to improving customer satisfaction, service performance, and operational efficiency.
Undertake any other duties appropriate to the level of the role.

jobs.details_text:
Job Description Help make investing feel more accessible, one conversation at a time.
Social media is often where people discover AJ Bell, ask questions and join conversations about investing. As our Social Media Community Executive, you'll help make those interactions useful, engaging and genuinely human.
You'll build relationships with our online communities, listen to what matters to them and turn those insights into better content and conversations. You'll also create social-first content and use performance data to continually improve what we do, helping more people feel informed, confident and positive about investing.
What you'll do 
Bring our social media communities to life by responding to comments, messages and mentions in a timely, helpful and brand-appropriate way.
Build genuine relationships with followers, joining conversations and creating opportunities for people to engage with AJ Bell and investing.
Use social listening to understand what our audiences are talking about, spotting emerging trends, recurring questions and opportunities to make investing easier to understand.
Share community feedback and audience insights with colleagues across Content, PR, Brand and Marketing, helping us create communications that are relevant and useful.
Track reach, engagement, follower growth and community activity, using the results to understand what's working and where we can improve.
Schedule, publish and optimise platform-native content across Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn and other relevant social channels.
Create and adapt engaging social-first content, including short-form video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn, using tools such as Canva and Edits.
Help maintain a positive and trusted community by recognising when customer service, regulatory or reputational issues need to be escalated and following the right governance processes.
What you'll bring 
Experience managing social media communities and the judgement to respond to different customers, comments and conversations in a helpful and professional way.
A good understanding of platforms including Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook and YouTube, and curiosity about how people use them differently.
Experience with social media management and reporting tools such as Sprout Social, alongside the analytical skills to spot trends and turn performance data into useful insights.
Clear, engaging written communication and a natural ability to adapt your tone for different audiences and channels.
Good organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage different activities and deadlines while maintaining quality.
The confidence to recognise sensitive customer service, regulatory or reputational issues and escalate them appropriately.
A collaborative approach and an interest in using customer feedback and audience insight to make content and experiences better.
Experience creating social-first content, editing short-form video or using tools such as Canva and CapCut would be useful, but isn't essential. An interest in emerging social media and AI tools would also be welcome.
About AJ Bell 
At AJ Bell, we believe investing should feel good. Whether you're looking for an ISA, pension or dealing account, whether you want to invest with the help of a financial adviser or do it yourself, we have easy-to-use solutions to suit people from all walks of life.
We're one of the UK's fastest-growing investment platform businesses, trusted by everyone from professional financial advisers to first-time investors.
Today, over 762,000 customers trust us to manage more than £121.5 billion of assets. By continually striving to make investing simpler and more accessible, we're helping more people take control of their financial futures.

jobs.details_text:
Are you passionate about creating B2B marketing campaigns guided by cutting-edge marketing and digital best practices, that drive engagement and deliver business impact? 
Do you thrive on working closely with sales teams to develop campaigns, content and sales enablement activity that supports account growth? 
Could you take ownership of end-to-end campaign management and deliver marketing activity that connects customer challenges with a broad portfolio of products, services and solutions? 
At the IET, you'll do more than just a job. You'll help connect the people solving the problems that matter, making a meaningful contribution while developing professionally and personally. We're investing in our people through a modern workplace, hybrid working and a culture that supports growth.
If you're a commercially minded B2B marketer driven by curiosity and continuous learning, you'll join a supportive marketing and communications community of 40+ professionals, with plenty of opportunities to learn, collaborate and develop your career.
Hybrid Working Arrangement 
We support flexible working, with an expectation of being in our Stevenage office two days per week. Thursdays are our key team day, when everyone comes together to support collaboration and connection across the marketing team.
What you’ll be doing 
As one of our Marketing Campaign Managers, you'll lead B2B and sales enablement campaigns that support the IET's growth ambitions. You'll deliver integrated, insight-led campaigns that engage businesses, industry partners and professional audiences, taking activity from planning through to execution, optimisation and performance measurement.
Our B2B approach focuses on helping organisations address challenges around workforce capability, professional standards and business growth, rather than promoting products alone. You'll play a key role in bringing this strategy to life.
Working closely with Sales, Product and Portfolio Management teams, you'll deliver sector-focused campaigns, thought leadership and sales enablement activity that drive meaningful customer engagement and commercial growth.
You'll collaborate with Marketing Campaign Executives, Digital Marketing Executives, specialist marketing teams and external agencies to develop compelling content and campaign assets aligned to business objectives. Using data and insight, you'll optimise performance, demonstrate ROI and manage budgets effectively to maximise impact.
You'll help organisations understand how the IET can support their goals while equipping Sales teams with the content, tools and assets they need to maximise opportunities. As business priorities evolve, you'll also have the opportunity to support campaigns across other areas of the organisation.
What we hope you can bring to the role 
We’re looking for an experienced marketer with a strong track record of delivering end-to-end B2B campaigns. You'll be able to turn strategy into measurable activity, managing campaigns from planning through to delivery, optimisation and evaluation.
Organised and commercially minded, you'll manage multiple priorities while using insight and data to improve performance, demonstrate impact and maximise budget effectiveness. You'll work closely with colleagues across marketing, sales and delivery, as well as agency partners, providing clear briefs and direction to ensure successful campaign execution.
You'll also be supported to continue developing your skills through access to learning platforms such as Target Internet and Propolis, helping you stay current with marketing best practice and emerging trends.
A little more about the role 
Develop and deliver insight-led B2B marketing campaigns aligned to business objectives and commercial growth.
Create sales enablement, customer engagement and thought leadership activity that supports customer conversations, account growth and engagement.
Deliver sector-focused marketing that positions the IET as a trusted partner for workforce capability, professional standards and business growth.
Manage campaigns end-to-end, from planning and briefing through to delivery and evaluation.
Collaborate with Brand, Creative and Digital teams to produce effective content and campaign assets across multiple channels.
Coordinate activity across digital, email, partnerships, events and offline channels as required.
Monitor, analyse and report on campaign performance, using insight to optimise activity and demonstrate ROI.
Work closely with Sales, Impact and Member & Customer Engagement teams to support lead generation, conversion and customer engagement.
Manage campaign budgets effectively to maximise value and impact.
Apply audience segmentation and personalisation to improve campaign relevance and performance.
Keep up to date with marketing trends and best practice, applying learning to enhance campaign effectiveness.
A little more about what we’re looking for 
Proven experience delivering successful B2B marketing campaigns that support commercial objectives.
Experience working with Sales teams to create sales enablement activity, customer communications and engagement programmes.
Ability to translate customer needs and business challenges into compelling campaigns, content and marketing initiatives.
Strong knowledge of digital marketing channels, including email, PPC, search and social media.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use data and insight to improve performance and demonstrate impact.
Excellent planning and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
Experience briefing and working with creative teams and external partners to deliver high-quality, on-brand assets.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence, collaborate and delegate effectively.
Experience managing budgets and maximising return on investment.
A proactive and adaptable approach, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.details_text:
Weekend Community Home Helper, Winchester, UK Part-time
Job Description About the Role:
We invite parents returning to the workforce to join us at Home Instead as a Weekend Community Home Helper. This part-time role is perfect for those looking to contribute meaningfully on weekends, providing vital support and companionship to our clients, enhancing their overall quality of life.
Responsibilities:
Offer personalised care to clients at home during weekends, using your parenting and nurturing skills.
Engage in weekend activities with clients: meal preparation, light housekeeping, personal care.
Provide companionship, understanding each client's unique weekend needs.
Various weekend hours to match your family commitments, ensuring continuity of care.
Keep accurate care records; report significant client condition changes.
Attend training sessions to enhance your caregiving skills.
Weekend Work Benefits:
Ideal for balancing weekday family commitments or other engagements.
Relaxed and engaging weekend care activities, similar to family time.
Competitive weekend pay rates with additional incentives possible.
Tailored weekend care training and ongoing professional development.
Supportive team focused on weekend caregiving.
Essential Qualities:
Compassionate, empathetic individuals returning to work after parenting.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently.
Various hours to meet yours and clients' weekend needs.
Committed to continuous, high-quality care.
No experience needed; tailored weekend training provided.
Rewards of Weekend Care:
Satisfaction from enhancing clients' weekends.
Building meaningful client relationships.
Adding comfort and companionship to clients' weekends, much like caring for your own family.
About Home Instead:
A leading in-home care service provider, we're committed to enhancing client lives and supporting our carers, especially those dedicating their weekends to our mission.
Application Process:
Looking to make weekends more meaningful as you return to work? Send your CV and a cover letter explaining your motivation. Selected candidates will be invited to discuss the impact they can have as a Weekend Community Home Helper at Home Instead, utilising your invaluable parenting experience.
Qualifications 
Compassionate, empathetic individuals returning to work after parenting.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently.
Various hours to meet yours and clients' weekend needs.
Committed to continuous, high-quality care.
No experience needed; tailored weekend training provided.
Additional Information Requirements:
Driving Licence

jobs.details_text:
About The Role
Why choose us? 
BRUSH Group provides the energy solutions that help power our built world . From power transformers to switchgear and engineering solutions, for generations, the BRUSH brand has stood for engineering excellence. 
We are committed to supporting the global effort for industrial decarbonisation and sustainable development and have set ambitious objectives to achieve our target of net zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050. 
What's the role? 
BRUSH Power Solutions is currently looking to recruit a site manager to oversee and coordinate all on-site activities related to High Voltage (HV) electrical infrastructure projects. As a site manager, you will deliver all site-based construction elements associated with multi-discipline projects, on-time to fully satisfy customer requirements. You will aim to continually develop and improve communications and performance within the Projects and Construction Teams.
The successful candidate will demonstrate a full understanding of the construction of electrical, elements of a project life-cycle. From the planning stage, through construction and up to commissioning.
Working Conditions - 40 hours per week , Monday - Friday between 7.30am-4.30pm. The role will be site based within a live substation environment. Our sites are situated across the South of England - Our current sites are Mannington, Hungerford, Swindon , Chichester and Southampton. A Company Van will be provided.
Key Responsibilities: 
Liaising with all stakeholders to manage all construction activities, including progressing of programmes, risk assessments and method statements.
Holding Competent Person status (CP) administering the Electrical Safety Rules (ESR) and ensuring safety process are upheld onsite
Liaising with all Client Operations Teams throughout the construction phase.
Receiving, managing and issuing drawings for construction at site level, checking construction meets the requirements of design.
Working with the Team Leaders to ensure delivery on site is done safely, efficiently and is compliant.
Overseeing, co-ordinating and managing all completions.
Managing sub-contractor onsite activities.
Managing internal direct reports for Construction team.
Providing input into design reviews as and when required.
Plan in advance, provision of all documentation, resources, tools, materials, consumables H&S equipment and transport, to ensure safe and efficient construction. Demonstrate this planning by providing a 1-week and 3-week lookahead.
Managing and co-ordinating site Acceptance Testing as required.
Managing the delivery of all ‘As-Built’ documentation throughout the onsite construction & commissioning phases.
Completing site audits and inspections when required, ensuring the highest standard of quality is maintained
What we’re looking for: 
Experience of industrial electrical containment construction in accordance with current electrical regulations.
SMSTS Certification required.
Goodknowledge of safe systems of work, with either a recognised industrial/commercial electrical apprenticeship or a relevant degree-level qualification
Strong site management and coordination skills, with the ability to plan, organise and control multiple construction activities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to liaise effectively with clients, operations teams, subcontractors and internal teams.
Strong understanding of electrical construction, safety rules, commissioning and acceptance testing.
Effective planning and problem-solving skills, including the ability to manage programmes, resources, risks and 1-week/3-week lookahead plans.
Strong leadership and quality management skills, with the ability to manage site teams, subcontractors, inspections, audits and completion activities.
Experience 
Proven experience working as a Site Manager or in a similar construction management role on multi-discipline/electrical projects.
Experience managing projects through the full construction lifecycle, from planning and construction through to commissioning and handover.
Experience managing subcontractors, direct reports and multidisciplinary site teams to deliver work safely, efficiently and to programme.
Experience managing construction documentation, including drawings, risk assessments, method statements, as-built information and completion records.
Experience working within electrical safety procedures, including Electrical Safety Rules, site inspections, quality assurance and acceptance testing.
About The Organisation
BRUSH Power Solutions is able to deliver at every stage of a project’s lifecycle. From initial design and consultancy through to construction, testing, commissioning and connection, the team are on hand to provide comprehensive end-to-end HV infrastructure solutions for projects from 11kV to 400kV.
Along with the expertise BRUSH Power Solutions offers, our wider Power division also includes specialist ICP-accredited energy infrastructure contractor, McGowan Infrastructure. jobs.details_text:
About The Role
Why choose us? 
BRUSH Group provides the energy solutions that help power our built world . From power transformers to switchgear and engineering solutions, for generations, the BRUSH brand has stood for engineering excellence. 
We are committed to supporting the global effort for industrial decarbonisation and sustainable development and have set ambitious objectives to achieve our target of net zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050. 
What's the role? 
The Quality Manager at BRUSH Power Solutions leads and manages the quality assurance and control processes for the design, manufacturing and installation of substations across the UK. This role is crucial in ensuring compliance with industry standards, regulatory requirements and customer specifications while driving continuous improvement and operational excellence. 
Work conditions - 37.5 contractual hours per week , Monday - Friday. Hybrid working. The requirements of the role will be an active site presence around BRUSH Power Solutions substation South patch which is primarily Dorset, Hampshire and West Sussex areas with minimum monthly visits to the Highlands / Aberdeenshire. Car allowance will be provided.
Key Responsibilities: 
Lead and manage the Quality team.
Develop, implement, and maintain Quality Management Systems (QMS) for substation design and installation projects.
Ensure compliance with National Grid, IEC, BS EN, and ISO 9001 standards, as well as health, safety, and environmental regulations.
Oversee quality assurance across design, procurement, manufacturing, and installation phases.
Conduct inspections, audits, and risk assessments to identify quality issues and implement corrective actions.
Collaborate with engineering, project management, and site teams to ensure quality standards are met.
Work closely with clients, subcontractors, and suppliers to maintain quality standards and resolve any non-conformances.
Maintain and improve documentation, reporting, and compliance records.
Provide training and mentorship to project teams on quality best practices.
Regular site visits across the UK 
What are we looking for: 
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Quality Management, or related field.
CQI qualification
5+ years of experience in quality management within the power, transmission, or substation industry
Certification in Lead Auditor (ISO 9001)
Full UK Driving Licence and willingness to travel extensively
Experience working as a solo contributor
Experience of working with Distribution network Operators.
Experience in UVDB Achilles accreditation
Experience in National Electricity Registration Scheme (NERS) accreditation
What' s in it for you? 
Competitive salary 
Holiday allowance starting at 26 days per annum plus bank holidays (pro rata for part time roles)
Flexible and Hybrid working options (role dependant)
Life insurance – 4 x annual salary 
Enhanced Company Pension scheme 
24/7 free and confidential Employee Assistance Programme 
GP24 Service – Access to remote, private GP services 24/7, 365 days a year plus Second Medical Opinions.
BRUSHRewards – Discover plenty of ways to get more active and make great savings on everyday essentials as well as gifts for loved ones, holidays and special treats for yourself.
Family friendly policies including Enhanced Maternity/Paternity
Bike2work scheme 
Long Service Awards
Developing our people is important to us - we support and encourage development by offering ongoing professional development and training.
About The Organisation
BRUSH Group provide agile and adaptive engineering solutions and products, including consultancy services, design, and project management as well as award-winning product technology, to a wide range of projects.
A chosen partner for national and regional power generation and distribution network operators, through innovation and a commitment to delivering solutions that address grid-resilience and drive system change, we support the global drive to net-zero, helping create a future-proof Infrastructure. /p

jobs.details_text:
We’re looking for an enthusiastic and highly organised Product \Marketing Manager to join the marketing team at a leading London based trade publisher. This is a fantastic opportunity to take ownership of your own portfolio of titles and work across a fabulous list of products and iconic brands. If you’re passionate about publishing, thrive in a fast-paced environment and love working on projects that captivate audiences, we’d love to hear from you. This role offers hybrid working, with three days in the London office and two days working from home.
The Role 
You’ll coordinate and schedule marketing activity across the full product lifecycle, from market research and product testing through to launch and subsequent launches in additional territories. You’ll also organise and manage consumer focus groups to explore research and new concepts.
Responsibilities will include:
• Developing creative, compelling and engaging printed marketing material for product tests and launches.
• Plan and optimise customer acquisition campaigns through effective digital marketing campaigns, including SEM, social ads, display and email.
• Monitoring campaign performance and spend to achieve acquisition targets and improve retention.
• Supporting the Senior Product manager with the development of TV advertising.
• Briefing web design agencies and overseeing subscription websites creation with a focus on user experience.
• Creating and managing P&L spreadsheets for your titles.
• Working closely with other relevant departments, including logistics, editorial and production as well as other commercial partners.
About You 
You’ll have at least two years’ marketing experience, preferably in a B2C environment, and ideally in the publishing industry, although candidates with strong operational planning skills will also be considered. You will have a strong understanding of digital and direct marketing and experience of subscription or membership products would be useful but not essential. The ability to develop compelling marketing copy; visuals and multimedia content is essential, as is a pro-active, problem-solving approach, with the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
This role offers the opportunity to join a collaborative, supportive team in a unique and creative industry, with great opportunities for professional development and progression. The role offers an attractive salary, good company benefits and hybrid working.
If you’re ready for a rewarding, varied and exciting next step in product marketing please send your CV and a short cover note.

jobs.details_text:
Brand Marketing | Events | Thought Leadership | Social | Account-Based Marketing 
16 Years at the Forefront of Social Media for Much-Loved Brands. Now It’s Our Turn.
Since 2010, Truffle Social has helped brands people genuinely love find their voice on social media. We were the UK’s first agency to purely “do” social, and we’ve spent every year since building thriving communities from nothing but pure social spark.
We’re an independent, female-led agency based in Farringdon, working across fashion, beauty, hospitality, food, drink, property and sport. Our clients include Reiss, NARS, Hotel Chocolat, VOSS, Accor and This Girl Can .
Our growth has largely come through word of mouth, but now it’s time to tell our own story.
We’re hiring our first full-time Marketing & Communications Manager to build Truffle’s marketing from the ground up.
With your own budget, direct access to leadership and creative freedom, you’ll raise our profile through compelling content, events, PR and thought leadership.
The Role at a Glance 
Marketing & Communications Manager
Farringdon | London
Hybrid: Mondays and Thursdays in the office, plus events
Full-Time | Permanent
£45,000–£55,000 - Suggested
Plus comprehensive benefits and growth opportunity to Head of Marketing
Reporting to: Giselle, MD, with close working alongside Ellie our CEO
No Direct Reports (to begin with)
The Team, the Legends, the Hard Workers
We believe in the creativity of people. Our team brings together storytellers, designers, strategists and original thinkers.
Your role is to bring their ideas, opinions and personalities to life through engaging, shareable content.
The Work You’ll Get to Shout About 
You won’t be short of stories. A few from our portfolio :
• Reiss: content and events that took the brand to New York Fashion Week
• London Fashion Week: a shareable social strategy for Julien MacDonald’s show
• Sport England, This Girl Can: real-movement storytelling with community-led casting
• NARS: content and social strategy for product launches across retailers and socials
• Hotel Chocolat: creator campaigns and CGI ads
• Accor: launching the “Accor Live Limitless” rebrand on social
• Eylure: a TikTok makeover built on trend-led content
• Mr Pretzels: new Instagram and TikTok channels built from scratch for Gen Z and Gen Alpha
Why Now? 
Until now, freelancers have managed our marketing. We're ready for someone to take full ownership, building on three key developments:
New Brand Strategy: A clear identity, positioning and tone of voice.
Growing New Business Team: A dedicated commercial team you'll support by creating opportunities and opening doors.
Clear Target Market: Major beauty, fashion and lifestyle groups, with opportunities to build relationships across multiple brands.
The Opportunity 
You’ll get a healthy marketing budget, released quarterly, and the freedom to decide where it goes.
You’ll be: 
Key Responsibilities 
Marketing Planning: Turn budgets into an annual programme of events, awards and campaigns.
Partnerships: Secure sponsors, venues and co-hosts to maximise budgets.
Founder Visibility: Arrange speaking opportunities, podcasts and thought leadership content for Giselle and Ellie.
Events: Plan and deliver panels, client roundtables and leadership events.
Social Content: Capture and publish engaging, timely content from events.
PR & Awards: Develop case studies, award submissions and media opportunities.
Business Development: Support new business through targeted research, content, outreach and invitations.
Social Strategy: Lead Truffle’s social channels alongside the in-house team.
Reporting: Track performance, measure impact and identify improvements.
About You 
You'll have 3+ years' marketing experience , ideally within a creative, digital or social agency, or B2B professional services business .
You'll Bring: 
Strong social media knowledge and a social-first mindset.
Confidence networking, building relationships and securing opportunities.
A resourceful, commercially minded approach to budgets and partnerships.
Excellent writing skills across PR, awards, case studies and social content.
Experience delivering events, campaigns or ABM supporting new business.
Hands-on content creation skills using Canva, CapCut or Premiere Pro.
Strong organisation and the ability to manage multiple projects independently.
Confidence using data, spreadsheets and AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude.
Flexibility for office days (Mondays and Thursdays), events and occasional evenings.
Experience with Sprout Social, GA4 or HubSpot would be an advantage. 
You’ll need to be London or Home Counties based , so you know what’s happening in the industry and can be there when it does.
If you need a fixed two days a week and nothing more, this probably isn’t the role for you.
Benefits: 
• 24 days’ holiday plus bank holidays (32 days in total)
• Your birthday off
• Hybrid working from our Farringdon office, a short walk from the Elizabeth line
• Company away days and socials
• Mental health support and therapy services
• Quarterly mindfulness, meditation or fitness sessions
• Monday breakfast club and Thursday drinks
• Pension scheme
We see this role becoming our Head of Marketing. 
We’ve got 16 years of stories, a team worth knowing and ambitions that deserve a bigger audience. Now we need someone who sees the possibilities and can make them happen. If you’re already imagining the events you’d host, the stories you’d tell and the doors you’d open, we’d love to hear from you.
Apply now with your CV and a few words about why you’re the person to get Truffle talked about.
Application notice... We take your privacy seriously. As you might expect you may be contacted by email, text or telephone. Your data is processed by our talent partner RR (Recruitment Revolution) on the basis of their legitimate interests in fulfilling the recruitment process. Please refer to their Data Privacy Policy & Notice on their website for further details.

jobs.details_text:
Marketing & Communications Officer 
Part-time | 20 hours per week | South Kensington (office-based) 
Salary: £45,000–£48,000 FTE (pro rata)
Contract: 12-month fixed term, with the possibility of becoming permanent
Start date: ASAP
The organisation is looking for a creative, enthusiastic and organised individual who can help raise awareness of its work, engage supporters and bring its mission to life through engaging marketing and communications.
Whether you already have experience in marketing and communications or are looking to further develop your skills within the charity sector, this could be a brilliant opportunity to make a real difference.
The opportunity 
As Marketing & Communications Officer, you'll take the lead on the organisation's marketing, communications and digital engagement activity.
You'll be responsible for creating engaging content, managing social media channels, producing newsletters and website content, and helping to ensure the organisation's messaging and brand remain consistent across all platforms.
You'll also work closely with colleagues, particularly the Relationship Fundraiser, to support fundraising campaigns, share supporter stories and strengthen relationships with the charity's wider community.
This is a varied, hands-on role where creativity, initiative and the ability to get stuck in will be key.
Key responsibilities 
Develop and deliver engaging content across social media platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn.
Create and schedule social media posts, videos, graphics and supporter stories.
Maintain brand consistency and ensure a consistent tone of voice across all communications.
Produce newsletters, email updates and website content.
Support campaigns designed to raise awareness of the charity's work and the condition it supports.
Manage and maintain the organisation's webapp.
Monitor social media channels and respond to comments and messages professionally.
Monitor engagement and digital activity, producing reports for the Chief Executive.
Support digital fundraising campaigns through compelling content and storytelling.
Interview supporters, volunteers and clinicians to develop stories and case studies.
Edit and upload videos, graphics and other digital materials.
Work closely with the Relationship Fundraiser to support fundraising campaigns, events and supporter communications.
Provide occasional office cover during staff holidays or busy periods.
About you 
We're looking for someone who is creative, proactive and passionate about producing engaging communications.
You'll ideally have:
Experience creating and publishing content across social media and digital platforms.
Strong written communication skills and excellent attention to detail.
Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
The ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively.
A creative approach to content creation and storytelling.
Excellent organisational skills and the ability to take ownership of your workload.
A flexible, adaptable and hands-on approach.
A friendly and professional manner when communicating with supporters and external stakeholders.
Experience with graphic design, video editing or digital campaigns would be advantageous, as would previous experience within a charity or not-for-profit organisation.
Most importantly, you'll be enthusiastic, willing to get involved and comfortable working as part of a small, collaborative team.
What's on offer 
This is a lovely opportunity to join a genuinely friendly, small charity where people work collaboratively and everyone is valued.
Flexible working hours: The organisation is very accommodating and understands the importance of flexibility around working arrangements.
Supportive environment: A welcoming, down-to-earth team.
Creative freedom: The opportunity to bring ideas to the table and help shape the organisation's marketing and communications.
Training and development: The organisation is keen to support individuals in developing their skills.
Varied role: The opportunity to take ownership of different marketing and communications activities and make a real impact.
Part-time hours: 20 hours per week, with flexibility around how these are arranged.
Annual leave: 25 days plus bank holidays (pro rata).
Please note this is an office-based role in South Kensington, with some travel within the UK and occasional evening or weekend work.
Accessibility note: The organisation's offices are based in the crypt of a listed building in South Kensington. Please be aware that there is no lift access and entry to the offices involves climbing one flight of external concrete stairs.
If you're a creative communicator who enjoys producing engaging content, sharing stories and helping an organisation connect with its audience, we'd love to hear from you.
To apply, please send your CV and a covering letter outlining your relevant experience and why you're interested in the opportunity.
Interviews will be held on a rolling basis, so we encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible to avoid missing out on this opportunity.

jobs.details_text:
Social Content Creator & Community Executive London (Hybrid, 2 Days Per Week)
Up to £250/day (Outside IR35)
6-Month Contract
The Role We're looking for a Social Content Creator & Community Executive to create engaging, social-first content across Instagram and TikTok for a leading consumer wellness brand.
This is a hands-on content creation role focused on filming, editing and producing platform-native content, while also supporting community engagement and helping shape future creative through social insights.
Working closely with the Social & Content Manager, you'll take ideas from concept to delivery, creating content that feels native to platform and drives engagement across social channels.
What You'll Be Doing 
Create TikToks, Reels, Stories and short-form social content
Film and photograph content across events, activations, lifestyle and product shoots
Edit content using tools such as CapCut and Premiere Pro
Develop content ideas, shot lists and simple storyboards
Capture content at launches, PR events and partnerships
Create platform-specific content for both Instagram and TikTok
Manage community engagement across social channels
Respond to comments and identify content opportunities from the community
Monitor performance and optimise content based on insights
